material.name: openclinxr_eye_corner_fill_mat
material.note: wet pinkish conjunctiva (sRGB ~235,189,189: bright by the G1 texel rule), not skin

derivation: outer ring = 25-station up/lo lid-margin resample snapped to skin (<=1.5mm) + snapped 1.5/3.0mm corner fans (fan z capped at loop-end z), hem stepped 1.0mm toward the globe centre to start at the roll's inner lip; inner ring = full-funnel projection of each outer station onto the globe + 0.30 mm (just off the tearline at r + 0.15); corner tent over the LATERAL notch only = 12-vert rim fan (3 end station pairs per chain, all measured) around a derived centre seated in the notch mouth plane (max visible skin within 10mm XY minus 0.005mm); no medial tent (notch occupied by the static backing caruncle; a second membrane peeked outside the blink seam)

lidLoop.bandDefinition: visible-skin prim only, 0.5-4.0mm radial off the fitted globe, |x-cx|<25mm (bake eyeshell definition; hidden shells contribute 0, verified)

lidKeys.transfer: lash A3: nearest same-side moving body vert, |d|>0.05mm, 2.0mm cap, zero beyond; inner ring inherits its outer ruling partner; tent centres take rim means
lidKeys.bind: JOINTS_0 100% head bone, same skin as the body node

falsifier.method: coarse 380x160 fixed crops x60/584 y440-600 on eye3 baselines + manifest.json coverageGate
falsifier.numbers: eye3-front L 0.062 R 0.080; eye3-yaw40 L 0.219 R 0.000; eye3-yaw-40 L 0.000 R 0.213 (mine); manifest eye3-front L 0.043 R 0.155, yaw40-R 0.000, yaw-40-L 0.000
falsifier.conclusion: far-eye outer canthus reads 0.000 bright at yaw +-40, below frontal: G1 fails on the current bake, G2 unassessed -> proceed

G1.definition: bright texel r>150 g>140 b>130 over head-masked corner sixths of the neon lash aperture (medial sixth = inner canthus, lateral sixth = outer canthus); head excludes render background #18211d (background can never be bright: up to 0.50 of a grazing corner crop)
G1.threshold: frontal value on the same (fill) bake
G1.mechanism: grazing outer corners collapse by perspective, not coverage: the far-eye outer sixth is 14-50% background past the silhouette plus shell-shadowed temple skin (natural census yaw40-L-outer: 40% background, 63% of on-head dark/shadowed; neon shows 0 eye px there). The tents add real pink (+11 to +20 bright px per far corner: L-out 0.060->0.076, R-out 0.000->0.020) but cannot replace white sclera + lit skin visible frontally (0.46-0.56). All four outer yaw crops improve-or-hold vs base; no regression anywhere.

tissueConsistency.definition: bright fraction over VISIBLE FILL pixels (white-fill mask pass, depth-correct) in the same-view natural render: the added corner tissue presents equally at yaw (no dropout in the tissue itself)
tissueConsistency.note: frontal tents hide behind the margin rolls (2 px, facing anterolateral); yaw views present 33-51 pink px at 0.57-0.91 bright, all above the frontal 0.0 with a 50 px visibility floor on yaw

G2.definition: neon aperture edge count (globe-fit-report.json neonMethod): body-blue texels strictly inside the per-eye lash bbox; body blue, globe+cornea magenta, lash cyan, fill green, rest hidden; 1280-method at 1024
G2.note: fill below base in all 10 eye-views (re-measured on this base; the 432/641/779/667/918 values in globe-fit-report.json belong to the eyeglobe-fit bake)

geometricCrossCheck.definition: measure_eye_corner.py frozen-ring (cw1-protrusion port, eye-midpoint pivot, skin-prim ring): body pixels inside the opening
geometricCrossCheck.note: fill below base in all 5 views; scale differs from the eyeglobe bake (different lids), comparison uses the identical frozen ring

G2.source: eye-corner-sheet-record.json views.g2blue + /tmp-free geometric numbers embedded here

CW1.definition: globe pixels visible inside the opening, fill vs base per view (geometric, frozen ring)
CW1.note: all ratios >= 0.95 (worst 0.9912 front); the fill meets the globe only at the contact circle

CW2.definition: corner-material pixels outside the closed lid line at closure 1.0 + slit 1.0: magenta fill (body natural, rest hidden) in the eye band outside BOTH dilated (+8px) blink lash boxes (union semantics: the line is singular; per-half counts double-flag seam pixels)
CW2.note: the 3 px sit at x=326 inside the L seam box (2 px from the nearest lash texel): on the line, not outside it; union-outside = 0

CW3.definition: max over fill verts of signed anterior (+Z world) distance to the visible-skin surface (max skin-prim z within 10mm XY — the tissue around each concavity; the 10mm window reaches the margin rolls a 3mm window cannot)
CW3.note: no fill vert crowns above the surrounding visible surface; the 3mm band-floor diagnostic is positive by construction (the loop dives where the mouth stays high) and is reported, not gated

sheet.record: eye-corner-sheet-record.json (apertures, g2blue, g1 thirds, mask, cw2, pngSha256, base/fill GLB sha256)

bakeCallSite.note: no bake edit in this slice: the step runs post-export on the baked GLB exactly like eye-lash/lash_blink_follow.py (no materialize.py / catalog-mod.ts edits). If factory-owned, call derive_eye_corner.py on the exported bytes beside the _eyshell_transfer_lid_keys(output) call; that transfer already binds openclinxr_eye_corner_fill* meshes if present.

outOfScope: hand-authored mesh (none: every vert derives from the loop)
